metadata.aggregation: Only complete successful measured trials; median; p95 nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n).
metadata.ordering: All preflights, then seeded shuffle within each round; planned and executed orders recorded.
metadata.concurrency_clock: Closed-loop workers. Shared window starts after all opens/warmups and includes validation; ends at last worker execution completion. Per-call API durations exclude validation. Init/teardown separate; no overlapping backend batches. Payload resources exclude runtime/host overhead.

workload_definitions.resource_scope: payload Python process only; peak RSS includes interpreter; excludes backend/daemon/host
workload_definitions.marker_instrumentation: baseline/setup plain marker; concurrency instrumented marker

methodology.interval_method: percentile bootstrap with linearly interpolated percentiles
methodology.latency_estimand: median of per-session medians; concurrency uses per-batch medians
methodology.selection: complete passed sessions/batches only; all status and failure counts retained
methodology.pooled_statistics: descriptive only; p95 uses nearest rank and has no confidence interval
methodology.small_sample_policy: one unit: no interval; fewer than ten units: exploratory
methodology.pairing: explicit matching randomized round IDs within one profile/input file
methodology.multiplicity: intervals are pointwise, not adjusted for multiple comparisons
methodology.resource_scope: payload process CPU, wall time and peak RSS; not whole-sandbox or host resource usage
methodology.scope: conditional on this host, configuration and measurement period; not cross-host replication

methodology.latency_estimand: median of per-session medians; concurrency uses per-batch medians
methodology.selection: complete passed sessions/batches only; all status and failure counts retained
methodology.pooled_statistics: descriptive only; p95 uses nearest rank and has no confidence interval
methodology.small_sample_policy: one unit: no interval; fewer than ten units: exploratory
methodology.pairing: explicit matching randomized round IDs within one profile/input file
methodology.multiplicity: intervals are pointwise, not adjusted for multiple comparisons
methodology.resource_scope: payload process CPU, wall time and peak RSS; not whole-sandbox or host resource usage
methodology.scope: conditional on this host, configuration and measurement period; not cross-host replication
